defs.def: the top part of the front of the body, between the neck and the stomach 胸部；胸膛

ex.s: Students who are angry, afraid, or experiencing anxiety may have their arms crossed in front of their chests and their legs closed or crossed, like they are guarding their bodies.
ex.t: 生气、害怕或感到焦虑的学生可能会双臂交叉在胸前，双腿闭合或交叉，就像他们在保护自己的身体一样。

ex.s: At this moment a hard body struck me.Iheld ontoit; then IfeltthatIwas being drawn up, that I was brought to the surface of the water, that my chest collapsed my eyes closed, unconscious.
ex.t: 这时，一个坚硬的身体击中了我。抓住它；然后，如果正在起草，我被带到水面，我的胸部塌陷，闭上眼睛，无意识。

ex.s: To do CPR, you press on the sick person’s chest so that blood moves through the body and takes oxygen to organs.
ex.t: 做心肺复苏时，你按压病人的胸部，让血液流经全身，把氧气输送到各个器官。

defs.def: having the type of chest mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: I felt a small pain in my chest The dictionary was stolen at the end of my freshman year of college.
ex.t: 我感到胸口隐隐作痛。那本词典在我大学一年级结束时被偷了。

ex.s: Hardly had I written half a page when I felt a sharp pain in my chest
ex.t: 我刚写了半页，就感到胸口一阵剧痛

ex.s: The noise shakes the trees as the male beats his chest and charges toward me.
ex.t: 雄性大猩猩捶打胸口向我冲来的声音震动了树木。

ex.s: I always feel amazed when I see my grandfather’s huge medicine chest with countless small that store many herbs.
ex.t: 当我看到祖父的大药箱里有无数的小药箱，里面存放着许多草药时，我总是感到惊讶。

ex.s: Prepare your chest for his knife, Antonio.
ex.t: 准备好胸口准备他的刀，安东尼奥。

defs.def: a large strong box, usually made of wood, used for storing things in and/or moving them from one place to another （常为木制的）大箱子

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: Tell your mum to put her hand in the middle of his chest.
ex.t: 告诉你妈妈把她的手放在他的胸口中间。
